prompts.training: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create a single wide 16:9 editorial photograph for a high-school AI learning video. Believable 17-year-old student in ordinary dark green casual clothing at a light wooden study table, naturally attentive, seen over their left shoulder, comparing choices on a laptop. Natural window light, real skin and hands, mature documentary look, muted green and warm neutral palette like a candid classroom photograph. The student occupies the left third; laptop display dominates the middle and right two thirds and is nearly front-on, with unobstructed clearly bounded rectangular screen, all four display corners visible. One hand rests near trackpad. Screen is a plain pale ivory empty display for precisely typeset answer choices to be composited into the video later, no text or icons anywhere on screen. Laptop keyboard visible. No exaggerated grin, no business suit, no holograms, no decorative AI symbols, no watermarks. This teaches a person selecting helpful training feedback, not a generic posed portrait. Produce at high resolution.
prompts.embeddings: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create one wide 16:9 candid editorial photograph for a high-school AI learning video. Two believable 17-year-old friends, a girl with dark curly hair in an ordinary blue cotton shirt and a boy in a muted green overshirt, compare a small glass of dark fizzy cola beside a recognizable red Coca-Cola can with an ordinary ceramic mug of black coffee, at a light wood classroom table in natural window light. Girl visibly records ratings on a simple paper sheet using a pencil, boy points to the cola. Warm natural skin, realistic hands, mature photographic look, muted background. Faces and drinks clearly visible in upper 70 percent, tabletop and writing in center. Paper has six clean columns but no legible text or invented numbers; exact traits and numbers will be overlaid in video graphics. Lower 25 percent of frame mostly uncluttered tabletop for a readable explanatory strip. Convey observing characteristics and recording a rating, no floating icons, no science laboratory, no caffeine tasting measurement, no cartoon, no watermark. Keep camera sufficiently wide to fit both students and their hands, can and mug without cropping.
prompts.coins: Use case: photorealistic-natural, educational tabletop demonstration. Create one wide 16:9 high resolution photograph looking almost directly down at a light wood classroom table in soft natural daylight. Two small identical opaque matte navy shallow circular lids cover two stationary coins, left and right, spaced well apart on a horizontal line at about 52 percent of image height. Each lid fully hides its coin, no metal visible. A realistic teenager's right hand enters from upper left and rests gently on the edge of the LEFT lid, poised to lift it; the right lid is untouched with no hand nearby. Only these two lids and one hand, no other objects. The lids about 17 percent of image width each, centered at 30 percent and 70 percent of width. Leave clear wood above and below for typeset labels later. Documentary photograph, realistic fingers and shadows, consistent perspective. No text, no diagram, no icons, no watermark. This is the BEFORE state in a coin-reveal lesson; it must be unambiguous that neither result is visible.
prompts.coins_after: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the provided photograph to make the AFTER state of the same tabletop coin-reveal demonstration. Preserve exactly the camera, crop, wood grain, lighting, navy sleeve, and entire RIGHT navy lid fully hiding its coin at its original position. Change only the LEFT lid and the hand: the same hand has lifted the left lid up and back toward the upper left, uncovering one stationary metallic coin lying flat centered precisely where the left lid had been. The revealed coin must unambiguously be heads, a realistic embossed profile portrait on a silver US quarter; coin about half the lid diameter. Show the left lid still held by the same hand above and slightly behind its original position, far enough away that the entire coin face is unobstructed. No second visible coin, no text, no labels, no arrows, no changed objects, no new hands. Match the original photograph as tightly as possible. Keep wide 16:9.
